text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: That absolute fool!

An angry shout echoes across the training
grounds.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Going straight home the moment class ends?!
After how much
I drilled into her to come today... Ugh,
how long does she plan on slacking off?!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
She is truly a handful... Ugh,
perhaps I should have kept a closer eye
on her during her junior academy days to
make sure she grew up more diligent...

Holding her head in exasperation is Air Groove—
as expected of the
student council vice president,
her strict yet caring nature shines right
through.
choice_data_list: (Looks like she's having a tough t...

text_block_list.text:
That night—as soon as I get back to my room,
I boot up my PC to game.
Lately,
I've been hooked on the board game
Reversi.

While it's a simple classic,
the online matches get pretty heated.
That's because—

"Evening. Can you hear me okay?
—Alright, shall we begin?"
choice_data_list: Good to play with you again, Domi-san.

text_block_list.text:
It's also a chance to hang out with 'dominare'—
or Domi-san,
a veteran player who reigns supreme in the
online gaming scene.

text_block_list.name: dominare
text_block_list.text:
"What's the plan for today? An 8x8 is fine,
but... isn't it
about time you tried stepping up to a 10x10
board?"

text_block_list.name: dominare
text_block_list.text:
"Haha, you think so? Well,
true enough. 10x10 Reversi has
way more squares,
so the tactical depth goes through the
roof."

text_block_list.name: dominare
text_block_list.text:
"In that case,
let's go all out on an 8x8 today.
I'm looking forward to seeing how much
stronger you've gotten."

Domi-san is a player I deeply admire.
Through a stroke of luck,
we ended up voice chatting
and playing regularly,
but I'm still constantly in awe of their
outstanding skill.

In Reversi,
the corners are everything!
Pouring all my focus into executing
the "corner capture" strategies I crammed
over the past few days—

text_block_list.name: dominare
text_block_list.text:
"Oho... Not a bad move.
You've clearly done your homework."

text_block_list.name: dominare
text_block_list.text: "——However, you're still too naive."

text_block_list.name: dominare
text_block_list.text:
"What do you think I was doing
while you were obsessing over securing all
four corners?"

text_block_list.name: dominare
text_block_list.text: "I was cutting off your escape routes."

What does that mean...?
Unable to understand right away,
I stare at the board.
—And then, it suddenly hits me.

text_block_list.name: dominare
text_block_list.text:
"Precisely.
You fixated too much on 'taking the four
corners.'
That's why you failed to notice me steadily
narrowing down your options."

text_block_list.name: dominare
text_block_list.text:
"Fixate too much on short-term gains,
and you lose sight of the bigger picture.
A focusing illusion—a textbook cognitive bias,
really."

text_block_list.name: dominare
text_block_list.text:
"Don't be bound by patterns.
Don't be blinded by single moves.
Dominating the entire board—
that is the true essence of board games."

A total defeat.
To be outplayed so effortlessly and
completely...

text_block_list.name: dominare
text_block_list.text:
"Haha,
I appreciate the kind words.
But your improvement rate is
quite impressive too.
You gave me a decent challenge today."

text_block_list.name: dominare
text_block_list.text:
"You'll get used to 10x10 in no time,
and you could probably pick up other board
games too, yeah?
It sounds fun to play chess or card games
with you sometime."

Terrifyingly enough,
Domi-san is knowledgeable about all sorts
of games, from
classics to the latest releases.
As someone who admires them—

text_block_list.name: dominare
text_block_list.text:
"Oh, interested? I can teach you whenever.
Maybe we could even
gather a group online for some social
deduction or territory-control games."

text_block_list.name: dominare
text_block_list.text:
"—Well, look at the time.
Let's call it a night for now.
Next time,
let's have a proper match on a 10x10
board."

text_block_list.name: dominare
text_block_list.text:
"Anytime works for me,
I'll match your schedule.
I'm basically always online,
so feel free to hit me up whenever you feel
like it."

Promising to play again over the weekend,
we wrap up our session for the day.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Come out right this instant,
you absolute fool!!

One afternoon,
I freeze in my tracks upon hearing Air
Groove's furious roar.
...Talk about déjà vu.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Ruler! Hey, answer me, Ruler!
Can you hear me?! Are you even awake?!

She is furiously banging on the door of a
small,
decrepit building in the corner of the club
room district.
Could it be that the troublesome student is
barricaded inside...?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Hm. You're... the Trainer. It's Ruler...
That slacker fool
has turned this place into her hideout and
locked herself inside.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Never mind that squandering an old,
unused club room
and claiming it as her own stronghold is
already a problem...

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Even though I drilled into her to show up
for training today,
she not only blew it off,
but she won't even answer me!

If she's merely ignoring me or fast asleep,
that's one thing, but
if she's collapsed from poor health or
something... that would be a disaster.
choice_data_list: Why not try calling her on LANE?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Good point... If she is fast asleep,
I'll shake her wide awake.
(Ringggggg—click!)

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
!! That girl... she hung up on me,
didn't she...?! 
—Hm, a LANE message? ...............
choice_data_list: What is it? Did she message you?
What's wrong? A message from her?

text_block_list.text:
"You're loud." "Busy playing online games
right now."
"Holed up until the day after tomorrow."

She's slacking off without a shred of
shame...
Locking herself away for three days is
something we can't just overlook.
choice_data_list: Is there any way to get her to com...

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Yes... If it comes to this,
we take forceful measures.

With that,
Air Groove pulls something from her
pocket— It's the key to the club room!!
The student council vice president's authority
shines bright...!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Today is the last straw!!
Everything up until now was merely leniency
on my part!!
Eeeek?!?!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove & ???
text_block_list.text:
"Get out here,
you fool!" "Whyyy?!
How'd you get the key?!"
"You are running today whether you like it
or not!!" "Wait, ow, whoa—!"

Hearing the muffled voice leaking out—
I suddenly feel like I recognize it from
somewhere.

W-Wait, let go of me, Air Groove-san!
I told you,
I have a massive gaming backlog to clear
todayyy~~!

Recognize it...? That's an understatement.
I hear this voice almost every single
week...!
Huh? Who're you...
